'''Bent Erik Sørensen''' (born 13 October 1941), is a Danish physicist, distinguished mainly by research into future forms of [[renewable energy]].<ref name="RUC"/> He is currently professor emeritus in the Department of Environmental, Social and Spatial Change in [[Roskilde University]], [[Denmark]],<ref name="Sørensen2007"/> and president of Novator Advanced Technology Consulting.<ref name="Sorensen2011"/>

==Biography==
Sørensen gained his MSc in physics and mathematics in 1965 and was awarded a PhD in 1974 by the [[Niels Bohr Institute]] in [[Copenhagen]], where he worked until 1980, when he became professor at Roskilde University.<ref name="RUC"/> He has undertaken sabbatical appointments in Japan, France, USA and Australia and has presented at numerous international events.<ref name="RUC"/>

He received the Australian Government Award for Eminent European Scientists in 1982 and the [[European Solar Prize]] in 2002.<ref name="Sorensen2011"/> In 1989, he was knighted by Queen [[Margrethe II of Denmark]].<ref name="RUC"/>

==Publications==
Sørensen has published over five hundred articles, reports and papers, and has written a number of books, including:
*{{cite book|author1=Johannes Jensen|author2=Bent Sørensen|title=Fundamentals of energy storage|year=1984|publisher=Wiley|isbn=978-0-471-08604-8}}
*{{cite book|author1=Bent Sørensen|author2=Paul Breeze|title=Renewable Energy Focus Handbook|date=29 December 2008|publisher=Academic Press|isbn=978-0-12-374705-1}}
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sørensen|title=Renewable Energy Conversion, Transmission, and Storage|date=7 November 2007|publisher=Academic Press|isbn=978-0-12-374262-9}}<ref name="Sørensen2007"/>
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sørensen|title=Renewable Energy: Physics, Engineering, Environmental Impacts, Economics & Planning|date=19 November 2010|publisher=Academic Press|isbn=978-0-12-375025-9}}
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sorensen|title=Life-Cycle Analysis of Energy Systems: From Methodology to Applications|date=6 June 2011|publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry|isbn=978-1-84973-145-4}}
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sorensen (Sorensen)|title=Hydrogen and Fuel Cells: Emerging Technologies and Applications|date=15 November 2011|publisher=Academic Press|isbn=978-0-12-396503-5}}<ref name="Sorensen2011"/>
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sørensen|title=Renewable Energy: Renewable energy technologies II|year=2011|publisher=Earthscan|isbn=978-1-84407-867-7}}
*{{cite book|author=Bent Sorensen|title=A History of Energy: Northern Europe from the Stone Age to the Present Day|date=17 January 2012|publisher=Taylor & Francis|isbn=978-1-84971-384-9}}
